serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Loop Electric Vehicle Charging Network-Gov (LEVCN-GOV) is a comprehensive Electronic Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure system and management solution tailored for US federal and associated customers. This cloud-based information system efficiently manages and processes transactions for EV charging stations, seamlessly communicating with stations located at client sites. It facilitates interactions between public, government users, and the charging infrastructure, initiating charging sessions, and handling payments or account authorizations. Moreover, Loop's system diligently safeguards customer and organizational data, promising efficient services for both individual end users and larger entities. Loop provides agency EV fleet and facility managers with comprehensive oversight and control over charging stations and sessions via an intuitive web-based portal. The platform is capable of integrating with pre-existing agency networks and systems. For added convenience, users can leverage the Loop mobile app, RFID tag or traditional payment methods for a smooth charging experience.
